faq.q: Which presentations is CampusDeck built for?
faq.a: College work comes first: final year projects, project reviews, mini projects, seminars, internships, research presentations and hackathon pitches. Corporate, business, healthcare, research and event decks are built to the same standard.

faq.q: Can one template cover Review 1, 2 and 3?
faq.a: Yes. Review templates follow the three-stage structure most departments use, so you add slides as the project grows instead of starting a new deck for each review.

faq.q: Will the slides open in PowerPoint?
faq.a: That is the plan. Templates are designed for editable PowerPoint export, with PDF for sharing. Export is not connected in this prototype, so the download dialog creates no file.

faq.q: Can I add my college logo?
faq.a: Academic covers include a logo position. Uploading your own logo arrives with the full editor.

faq.q: What slide size do the templates use?
faq.a: Every template is 16:9 widescreen, the default for most campus projectors and meeting-room screens.
